title: Present perfect vs Past simple
recall: Qachon present perfect, qachon past simple? Vaqt so'zlari bo'yicha 3 tadan misol ayt.
formula: Past simple: aniq o'tgan vaqt (yesterday, in 2019, last week, ago, when?) — voqea tugagan
Present perfect: vaqt aytilmagan yoki tugamagan davr (today, this week, ever, yet, since) — hozirga bog'liq
Savol 'When…?' — doim past simple: When did you arrive? (When have you arrived — xato)

pairs.b: I lost my phone last week.

pairs.a: My father has worked here for 10 years.
pairs.b: My grandfather worked there for 10 years.
What did you eat for breakfast?

en: I saw this film yesterday.
I watched this film yesterday.
I saw this movie yesterday.
I watched this movie yesterday.
Yesterday I saw this film.
I have seen this film.
I have seen this movie.
I have watched this film.
I have watched this movie.
When did you come?
When did you arrive?
When did you get here?
I went to London in 2019.
In 2019 I went to London.
I have been to London twice.
I have been to London two times.

items.uz: Bobom Rossiyada 10 yil ishlagan. (u vafot etgan)
en: My grandfather worked in Russia for 10 years.
My grandfather worked in Russia for ten years.

items.uz: Otam 10 yildan beri shu zavodda ishlaydi.
en: My father has worked at this factory for 10 years.
My father has been working at this factory for 10 years.
My father has worked in this factory for 10 years.
My father has been working in this factory for 10 years.
My father has worked at this factory for ten years.
My father has been working at this factory for ten years.
I drank coffee this morning.
I had coffee this morning.
This morning I had coffee.
This morning I drank coffee.

items.uz: Men bugun ko'p ishladim. (kun hali tugamagan)
en: I have worked a lot today.
I have done a lot of work today.
Today I have worked a lot.
Have you heard the news?
When did you hear it?
When did you hear about it?
When did you hear?
I have lost my phone and I can't find it.
I have lost my phone, I can't find it.
I have lost my phone and can't find it.
I lost my phone last week.
Last week I lost my phone.
Ali hasn't called yet.
Ali hasn't phoned yet.
Ali has not called yet.
Ali didn't call yesterday.
Ali didn't phone yesterday.
Yesterday Ali didn't call.
I have known Ali since I was a child.
I have known Ali since childhood.
I have known Ali since I was a kid.
I met Ali at school.
I got to know Ali at school.
Have you had breakfast?
Have you eaten breakfast?
Have you had breakfast yet?
Have you had your breakfast?
What did you eat for breakfast?
What did you have for breakfast?
They have got married!
They have gotten married!
They got married!
They got married in 2015.
They were married in 2015.
I haven't exercised this week yet.
I haven't exercised yet this week.
I haven't worked out this week yet.
I haven't done any sport this week.
I haven't exercised this week.

items.uz: O'tgan hafta har kuni sport qildim.
en: I exercised every day last week.
Last week I exercised every day.
I worked out every day last week.
Last week I worked out every day.
I did sport every day last week.
This company was founded in 1990.
This company was established in 1990.
The company has grown a lot since then.
Since then the company has grown a lot.
The company has grown a lot since that time.
How long have you lived here?
How long have you been living here?
When did you move to this house?
When did you move into this house?
I have never eaten such delicious food.
I have never eaten such delicious food in my life.
I have never had such delicious food in my life.
I have never had such delicious food.
I have never eaten such tasty food in my life.

items.uz: O'tgan yili bir marta kasal bo'ldim.
en: I was ill once last year.
I got sick once last year.
I was sick once last year.
Last year I was ill once.
Last year I got sick once.
Have you seen my keys?

speak: Hayotingdagi 3 ta tajribani ayt (present perfect), keyin har biri qachon bo'lganini ayt (past simple).
Bu hafta nima qilding va o'tgan hafta nima qilding — farqini ko'rsat.
Ishing haqida: qachon boshlading va o'shandan beri nima o'zgardi?

film.en: Harry has lived with his aunt and uncle since he was a baby.
film.note_uz: has lived — hozirgacha; since + past simple (was) — boshlanish nuqtasi

film.en: He told his wife that he was working late at school.
